statement: Unless the certificate of incorporation provides otherwise, Delaware stockholders may act without a meeting by consents signed by holders of at least the minimum number of votes that would be necessary at a meeting at which all shares entitled to vote were present and voted, and prompt notice of a less-than-unanimous consent must be given to non-consenting stockholders (8 Del. C. § 228(a), (e)).
caveat: Venture financing documents commonly modify or restrict § 228 consent rights; check the charter before relying on the default. This repo does not determine vote thresholds for a specific action.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
